description:
Get aiInsights from copilot

TIP: Lists AI-generated insights for a specific meeting (Copilot's meeting recap). Each insight has type (summary | actionItems | keyTopics | mentions), content (the actual AI-generated text), createdDateTime. Returns multiple insights per meeting — one per insight type. Use as a lightweight alternative to extracting the full meeting recording / transcript when you need the AI summary not the raw content. PRIVACY CAVEAT: AI insights derive from the meeting transcript — same sensitivity as the raw transcript. Document the investigative purpose.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-ai-meeting-insights
